d:
Anant Singh Allegation: mokama vidhayak anant sinh ne patna men pres varta kar dularchand yadav hatyakand aur kort ke sarendar aadesh par apni bat rakhi. is dauran unhonne niraj kumar par ganbhir aarop lagate hue dava kiya ki unhen is mamle men phansaya gaya hai. anant sinh ne kaha ki unhen nyayalay par bharosa hai aur bel milne ki ummid hai.
Pres varta men anant sinh ne nitish kumar ka bhi jikr kiya. vahin, mokama chunav men bete ke utarne ke saval par unhonne kaha ki ab yah phaisla beta hi karega.
Anant sinh ne niraj kumar ko lekar aur kya kaha? dekhie yah puri riporta.
AnantSingh
